summary: Pass the cookie URL and profile path to pycookiecheat as argv instead of interpolating them into the python -c program.
reason: Chrome profile discovery accepts any directory named 'Profile *' under the data dir, and the resulting path was only slash-normalized before being embedded in a double-quoted Python string literal. A profile name containing a quote, backslash or newline could close the literal and execute arbitrary Python during 'auth login --chrome'. argv has no quoting context, so the injection class is removed rather than escaped around.
validated_outcome: go build, go vet and go test ./... all clean; Greptile P1 'Unescaped profile path executes Python' addressed.
